notes.title: Version 1.0.04 Update
notes.content:
Fixes:

Gallery: Forms without an open mouth asset disappearing when clicked.

Death Scenes: Player death scenes are not triggered when they should.

Softlock Issue: Occurs when spamming, pressing, or clicking during a transformation.

notes.title: Version 1.0.03 Update
notes.content:
More achievement fixes!

Thank you for the support so far! 

Though it's still depressing to think people still think the game has "stolen" and "traced" arts when all of the reported ones have been removed/fixed.

T_T

Anyway, hopefully this is the last update for now :)

Goodnight!!
